keySentence: Sara treated everyone with equal kindness.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Lavinia once asked Sara why she spent time talking to the servant girls. She said that servants were different and should be treated differently by everyone. Sara looked at her calmly and said she simply did not see the world that way. She had once been the richest student in the school and was now a servant herself. She knew from her own experience that a person's worth does not change with their position. Becky deserved kindness not because of what she did but because of who she was as a person. Sara never adjusted her warmth or her attention based on how much money someone had. Sara treated everyone with equal kindness.
facts.Word cards: treated = 대했다 / equal = 동등한 / kindness = 친절 / regardless = 상관없이
